name: anti-ai
description: Rewrite AI-generated text to pass as human — to readers and to statistical detectors — using validated recipes (discourse fracture, interleave protocol) plus a deterministic linter (scripts/tellscan.mjs) that machine-verifies the self-check. Explicit invocation only: user types /anti-ai or names the skill; never fires on paraphrased intent like 'humanize this'.
